I only hope this will last me until I can see some results. I should also mention that it makes your eyelids turn red. Not a big deal but might bother some people.
reviews.title: Small amount, cheap packaging

comment.content: Hello Tania! Thank you for sharing your experience with us. We appreciate your feedback and will strive to improve our packaging and product quantity. We hope to see you soon for better results🩵
